abilities: Read and search your mail (IMAP)
Send email as you (SMTP)
Move messages and manage folders and labels
ConnectorEntry.description: Read, search and send email from your Gmail account.

fields.hint: The Google account you made the app password in.
fields.label: Gmail address

steps: App passwords need 2-Step Verification. If it is off, turn it on first at myaccount.google.com/security.
Click Open Google App passwords below and sign in.
Type a name such as Dots and click Create.
Copy the 16-letter password Google shows. It is shown only once.
Paste it below with your Gmail address. Spaces don't matter.
To stop, click Disconnect here and delete the app password on the same Google page.

ConnectorEntry.name: Gmail
ConnectorEntry.note: Made by codefuturist, not Google. Its program runs on this PC and gets your app password.

abilities: Read code, issues and pull requests in the repositories you allow
Open and comment on issues and pull requests
Search code and repositories
ConnectorEntry.description: Work with repositories, issues, pull requests and code on GitHub.

steps: Click Open GitHub below. It opens GitHub's New fine-grained token page; sign in if asked.
Name the token Dots and pick when it expires.
Under Repository access, choose the repositories your dots may work on.
Under Permissions, give what they need, for example Contents, Issues and Pull requests: Read and write.
Click Generate token and copy it. GitHub shows it only once.
Paste it below. To stop, click Disconnect here and delete the token on GitHub.

ConnectorEntry.name: GitHub

abilities: Read messages in channels and direct messages you can see
Search messages and look up people
Posting messages is off in this connector
ConnectorEntry.description: Read channels and direct messages and search your Slack workspace.
ConnectorEntry.error: The Library already has an MCP server named slack of your own.

steps: Click Open Slack apps below and sign in. Click Create New App, then From scratch, name it Dots and pick your workspace.
Open OAuth & Permissions. Under User Token Scopes add: channels:history, channels:read, groups:history, groups:read, im:history, im:read, mpim:history, mpim:read, users:read and search:read.
Scroll up and click Install to Workspace, then Allow. Your workspace admin may need to approve it.
Copy the User OAuth Token (it starts with xoxp-).
Paste it below. To stop, click Disconnect here and remove the app in Slack.

ConnectorEntry.name: Slack
ConnectorEntry.note: Made by korotovsky, not Slack. Its program runs on this PC and gets your Slack token. Slack's own server needs an app registered by Dots, which is not available yet.
